answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocal honest service to retain influence; a brief burst cannot survive the tide of time. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned Sybils have almost no trusted incoming mass and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed endorsements, leaving a hollow cluster unable to act as a beacon of trust or meet consensus thresholds.
